interface_inference.type: elementary interface comparison,not a new theorem or experiment
interface_inference.source_basis: NamSlyZhang2022 Section1.1 zero-field broadcast transition P;F231 finite field derivative is covariance
interface_inference.calculation: theta=tanh(beta);for zero-field free spins Cov(sigma_o,sigma_v)=theta^dist(o,v). In the radius-R ball the absolute root row is 1+d*theta*sum_{k=0}^{R-1}((d-1)*theta)^k. For binary X=(sigma+1)/2 divide by4. It grows without a uniform volume bound when (d-1)*theta>=1.
interface_inference.consequence: In the part of the old admissible high-degree regime beyond uniqueness,the original Ising coding cannot be admitted merely by substituting its law into F231 uniform absolute response inverse. Shared posterior Brownian mechanism is not a general subsumption claim.
interface_inference.limit: No assertion that every alternative representation fails;no new threshold or finite algorithm;unknown c,d0 not set numerically.
